app_fee.value: The graduate application needs a non-refundable $60 fee, and applications without it are not processed.
app_fee.quote: A non-refundable $60 application fee, payable through a U.S. Bank must accompany the application

fee_waiver.value: The bulletin pages checked do not describe a graduate application fee waiver. The College of Medicine says it offers none (see its program record).

gre_general.value: Set by each program; see the program record.
gre_general.quote: Standardized test scores may be required by specific graduate programs for admission.

toefl_min.value: International graduate applicants whose native language is not English need a TOEFL minimum of 71, unless exempt.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic minimum of 6 overall for international graduate applicants, unless exempt.

english_waiver.value: India is not on the bulletin's list of countries whose education waives the test, so Indian applicants need a test score. Some programs may still set their own rules.
english_waiver.quote: Certain graduate programs waive the English proficiency requirement for international applicants who are citizens of or who have attended school in specific countries where English is an official language and/or the medium of instruction

notes: Sources: 2026-27 University Bulletin graduate and international pages. The graduate school fee and test minimums come from the bulletin. Program-level GRE, English and fee rules are in each program record. The Graduate Deadlines page is at https://www.southalabama.edu/departments/admissions/graduate-deadlines.html.
